title: Billing Engineer - Civil
summary: A billing engineer measures what has been built on a construction project and turns it into bills, so the contractor is paid and subcontractors are paid correctly. They sit in the project's billing or quantity surveying (QS) team, working from drawings, the BOQ (bill of quantities) and site measurements.
dailyDuties: Take off quantities from architectural and structural drawings
Prepare client RA bills and check subcontractor bills against measurements
Record joint measurements with the site team and update measurement sheets
Prepare rate analysis for extra and non-BOQ items
Prepare bar bending schedules for steel work
Reconcile cement and steel issued against work done
Keep billing trackers and measurement sheets in Excel

skills.expectation: Take off quantities from architectural and structural drawings
Prepare a BOQ and do rate analysis for items
Prepare RA bills and check subcontractor bills against measurements
Read civil drawings well enough to measure from them
Prepare and check bar bending schedules
Build measurement sheets and bills in Excel
Agree measurements with site teams, clients and subcontractors
Keep measurement books and joint measurement sheets
Reconcile cement, steel and other materials
Measure areas and lengths from drawings in AutoCAD
Know CPWD or FIDIC contract terms for billing
Use site progress reports to check billed work
